subject: Multi-cloud marketplace listing & co-sell go-to-market
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@cloudshift.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudShift Sales Ops <partners@cloudshift.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint marketplace listing opportunity + co-sell with CloudShift

Hi Vanessa / Sergio,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week — CloudShift really likes Redwood's runtime story and wants to explore a joint listing across AWS, GCP, and Azure marketplaces followed by a co-sell pilot targeting regulated fintech customers.

High level ask: can Redwood list a verified offering (BYOC & hosted options) in each marketplace and agree to a co-sell/go-to-market package where we share lead qualification and some marketing spend for the first quarter? CloudShift will own initial integration work and GTM outreach; we envision Redwood handling the model-serving contract and SLA on the listing.

Attached: cloudshift_intro_deck.pdf (overview + target accounts).

Possible next steps: 1) confirm marketplace packaging requirements, 2) list of technical artifacts marketplace teams need, 3) a mutual action plan and timeline. Can you introduce your AWS/GCP partner contacts and your legal ops person?

Quick Q: is there a standard Redwood marketplace listing checklist we can use?

Cheers,
Julia Park
Strategic Partnerships
CloudShift Consulting

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@cloudshift.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace listing opportunity + co-sell with CloudShift

Julia — great to hear from you and excited about this. Looping in our partner ops and SEs to scope the technical checklist and time estimate.

@Chloe: can you review the deck and draft a short doc with the marketplace technical artifacts (images, offer types, usage metering, sourcing for billing integration)? I've attached a short Redwood template: redwood_marketplace_requirements.docx.

@Sergio: we should align on commercial structure (listing fees, referral splits, co-marketing budget). Suggested initial cadence: discovery call next Thurs 11am PT with AWS/GCP partner reps and CloudShift. Vanessa will host the call.

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_requirements.docx

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Julia Park <julia@cloudshift.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 May 2026 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace listing opportunity + co-sell with CloudShift

Quick notes after reviewing the deck:

- We need clarity on who pays the marketplace listing fees vs. referral/commission splits. Historically Redwood has absorbed minimal listing costs for strategic partners but expects cost share for paid marketplace features (e.g., lead gen placement, paid search).
- Can CloudShift provide an estimate of expected new qualified leads/month for the pilot? We want to model cost per qualified lead and ROI.
- Also tagging this as "co-sell pilot" in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/123456789/CLOUDSHIFT-2026-01. Please drop projected MQLs by next call.

Short ask for discovery: list of marketplaces you want to prioritize (AWS / GCP / Azure) and which offer types (private offer, SaaS on marketplace, AMI/BYOL listing).

— Sergio
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Julia Park <julia@cloudshift.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft mutual action plan + legal contacts

Hi all — attaching a first-pass mutual_action_plan.xlsx and the Redwood marketplace terms (marketplace_tnc.pdf).

Summary of items in the MAP:
- Phase 0 (week 0–2): partner intake, NDAs, select marketplaces (AWS + GCP pilot)
- Phase 1 (week 2–6): technical artifact submission, billing integration, compliance review (SOC 2 artifacts)
- Phase 2 (week 6–12): listing approval, joint marketing, co-sell enablement

Legal: our contracts lead is Priya Natarajan (priya@redwood.com) — copying her on the next thread for contract redlines and required data processing terms. Julia, please share your legal contact for DocuSign.

DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.com/sign/mutual-action-plan-id

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@cloudshift.com>, Amy AWS <amy.aws@amazon.com>, Diego GCP <diego.gcp@google.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Next steps: marketplace pilot kickoff (AWS & GCP) + co-sell playbook draft

All — thanks for moving quickly on this. Confirming the pilot will focus on AWS Marketplace (SaaS and Private Offers) and GCP Marketplace (SaaS). Azure to follow in Q3 depending on listing complexity.

Immediate next steps:
1) Julia / CloudShift: share expected MQLs and target account list by EOD Fri 23 May.
2) Chloe: publish the technical artifact checklist and a sample usage metering config by Fri 23 May.
3) Marissa / Priya: finalize MAP and send DocuSign for signature. Marissa — please include a clause for shared marketing spend for first 90 days.
4) Sergio: prepare pricing scenarios for cost-share vs Redwood-absorbed listing fees; we will review on the 27 May commercial sync.

I'll set the kickoff meeting (invite to follow). Also drafting a short co-sell playbook that outlines lead routing (CloudShift qualifies -> Redwood handles trial -> joint AE handoff) and SLAs for trial environments. Link to playbook draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-marketplace-playbook.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference
